dedupe_keys.name: eprel european product registry for energy labelling

description: EPREL, the European Product Registry for Energy Labelling, is a database operated by the European Commission with information on the energy and environmental performance of all product models that must be sold in the EU with an energy label, including household appliances, lighting and heating equipment, business-to-business products and tyres. The Energy Labelling Framework Regulation (EU) 2017/1369 required the Commission to set it up, and Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/994 governs details such as supplier identity checks; suppliers must register models before placing them on the market. Anyone can search, sort and compare models by product group, see parameter values and download product information sheets in all EU languages; for recently revised groups it links spare parts, repair instructions and dismantling information, and market surveillance authorities see extra non-public documentation. Coverage: energy-labelled products on the EU market. Access: free public website. Licence: free public access. Caveats: values are declared by suppliers, and product groups carry different parameters. Simulation uses are equipment efficiency inputs for building energy models and stock-level appliance scenarios. Related records: ENERGY STAR certified products data.
